'''Plorbaas''', also known as '''Plorbaas the Hutt''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Plorbaas was so wealthy that when his palace overflowed with luxuries and riches, he simply moved to a new palace, abandoning the old one and its contents.<ref name="Mission" />
